body:
WHAT
The update system only reports that a newer release exists; nothing is downloaded until the user clicks Update. On the self-update tier (NSIS, writable AppImage) the click starts electron-updater's download with progress percent, then offers 'Restart now' and installs on quit. On the assisted tier the click opens the browser on the matching asset.

WHY
Downloading an installer in the background without consent wastes bandwidth and surprises users on metered or restricted networks.

WHERE
app/main/updates.js — selfUpdater() sets autoUpdater.autoDownload = false and autoInstallOnAppQuit = true, wires update-available / download-progress / update-downloaded events into setState; checkNow() only calls checkForUpdates() or latestTag(); startUpdate() (status must be 'available') calls downloadUpdate() or shell.openExternal; installNow() calls quitAndInstall() only when status 'ready' and tier 'self'; initUpdates() arms FIRST_CHECK_DELAY_MS and CHECK_INTERVAL_MS timers (unref'd). app/main.js — ipcMain.handle("updates:state"|"updates:check"|"updates:start"|"updates:install"), broadcastToRenderers("updates:changed"). app/renderer/modules/updates.js renders the inspector footer.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. After initUpdates and checkNow with a mocked electron-updater, autoUpdater.autoDownload is false and downloadUpdate has not been called; only checkForUpdates was.
2. startUpdate() when status is not 'available' (e.g. 'uptodate' or 'downloading') returns without calling downloadUpdate or openExternal.
3. On the self tier, startUpdate() sets status 'downloading' with percent 0, a download-progress event with percent 42.6 sets percent 43, and update-downloaded sets status 'ready' and percent 100.
4. A downloadUpdate rejection records 'update-download-failed' and returns status to 'available' so the click can be retried.
5. installNow() calls quitAndInstall only when status is 'ready' and tier is 'self'; on the assisted tier it is a no-op.
